setup.free_parameter: eta (the mu-tau breaking), fitted to theta_13 only

verdict: THE TEST DISCRIMINATES. mode A: |dev23| predicted 10.09 deg vs observed 4.10 deg (x2.46); mode B: |dev23| predicted 2.49 deg vs observed 4.10 deg (x0.61). Mode A (e-mu/e-tau breaking) overshoots by ~2.5x and is disfavoured; mode B (mu-mu/tau-tau breaking) lands within 1.6 deg of the observed deviation (~39% low in magnitude) -- the right ballpark from ONE fitted parameter, but not a precision success. The structural content is that the mu-tau breaking must sit in the mu-mu/tau-tau entry, not the e-mu/e-tau entry.
reading: This is the falsifiable test Pass 259 set up: with the base matrix pinned by theta_12 and the mass-squared ratio, the mu-tau breaking eta is the ONLY freedom, so fitting it to theta_13 leaves theta_23 as a genuine prediction. The result is reported as it comes out. Note the SIGN of theta_23 - 45 is not predicted (flipping the sign of eta flips it while leaving theta_13 unchanged), so only the MAGNITUDE |theta_23 - 45| is a real prediction; the observed magnitude is 4.1 deg.
